description:
Per-payment dividend history (ex-date, amount, record, payment and declaration dates) plus trailing yield for one S&P 500 ticker.

    Served from cache. `status` is `available`, `no_dividends`, `pending` (the
    first request for a ticker warms the cache; ask again shortly) or
    `unavailable`. Same envelope as REST `GET /api/v1/dividends/{ticker}`.
name: get_dividend_history
